one_line: Ranadhira Kanthirava, 17th‑century Wodeyar ruler of Mysore and issuer of the famed Kanthiraya coins.

appearance.age_look: Late 30s to early 40s, medium‑tall and athletic with a sturdy warrior‑king build.
appearance.face: Oval face with a strong jaw, warm medium‑brown complexion, straight prominent nose, neatly groomed medium moustache with a slight curl at the ends, faint stubble along the jaw, sharp dark eyes with thick brows, default expression calm and calculating with a dignified, battle‑hardened seriousness.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair oiled and pulled back into a compact low bun at the back of the head, centre parting visible at the front; he wears a deep maroon silk pagri (turban) in a Mysore/Deccan style with pleated folds, a narrow golden band around its base, and a single small leaf‑shaped gold turban ornament slightly off‑centre above the forehead.
appearance.costume: He wears a long‑sleeved knee‑length angarkha/robe in muted off‑white cotton with a subtle cream woven stripe, overlapping right to left and tied with inner ties, over which he has a fitted sleeveless quilted coat (zabhoun‑like) of deep forest green cotton with vertical stitch lines and narrow gold piping at the edges; at the waist a broad dark maroon cloth sash (kamarbandh) wraps twice and is knotted slightly to the left, from which a small coin pouch hangs; his lower garment is a full, ankle‑length dhoti in soft pale beige cotton, pleated in front and wrapped firmly for riding and combat; he wears simple brown leather sandals with toe loops; on his arms, plain narrow gold bangles at each wrist, and he has small round gold stud earrings; across his chest a narrow dark‑brown leather baldric strap runs diagonally to support his sword scabbard.
appearance.signature: A slightly curved steel talwar with a traditional Indo‑Deccan hilt: disc‑shaped pommel, cross‑guard and knuckle bow in dull brass, wrapped grip; the steel blade is plain but impeccably maintained, housed in a dark‑brown leather‑covered wooden scabbard with simple brass chape, and in his left hand he often displays a single large silver Kanthiraya coin, held between fingers as a symbol of his monetary innovation.

ref_desc: Kanthirava Narasaraja I is a medium‑brown, strong‑jawed man in his early forties with a black low‑bun hairstyle under a deep maroon turban, wearing an off‑white angarkha, forest‑green sleeveless quilted coat, beige dhoti, maroon sash, and carrying a curved talwar and a silver Kanthiraya coin in deep maroon, forest green, beige, off‑white and brown tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full‑body anime‑style character model sheet of Kanthirava Narasaraja I: a medium‑tall, athletic, medium‑brown skinned man in his early forties with an oval face, strong jaw, neat medium moustache with slight curled tips, sharp dark eyes and thick brows, hair oiled back into a compact low bun with a visible centre part, wearing a deep maroon silk turban with tight pleats, a narrow golden band at its base and a small leaf‑shaped gold ornament above the forehead; dress him in a long‑sleeved off‑white cotton angarkha with subtle cream stripes, overlapping right to left, over which sits a sleeveless, fitted forest‑green quilted coat with vertical stitching and thin gold piping; wrap a broad dark‑maroon cloth sash firmly around his waist with a small coin pouch tucked into it; give him a full ankle‑length pale beige dhoti, neatly pleated in front, and simple brown leather sandals; add a narrow dark‑brown leather baldric strap diagonally across his chest holding a dark‑brown leather scabbard with brass fittings, narrow gold bangles on his wrists and small round gold stud earrings; in one hand show a slightly curved steel talwar with brass hilt and disc pommel, in the other hand he holds a single large silver Kanthiraya coin between his fingers, all rendered with consistent deep maroon, forest green, off‑white, pale beige and dark‑brown colours in a dignified, heroic pose suitable for repeated redrawing from multiple angles.
